source.title: OpenShell – A safe, private runtime for fleets of autonomous AI agents
source.author: niemandhier

title.zh: OpenShell：为自主AI代理提供安全运行时
title.en: OpenShell: A Safer Runtime for Autonomous AI Agents

excerpt.zh: OpenShell为自主AI代理提供隔离沙箱、内核级策略和凭证保护，但部署仍依赖受支持的平台与人工审查。
excerpt.en: OpenShell gives autonomous AI agents sandboxes, kernel-level policy enforcement, and credential controls, while deployment still depends on supported platforms and human review.

text.en: How OpenShell constrains autonomous AI agents

text.zh: OpenShell是NVIDIA推出的自主AI代理运行时，目标是让代理能够读取文件、安装软件包、调用API并使用受控凭证，同时避免获得对主机数据、密钥或网络的 unrestricted access。用户通过策略声明代理可以接触的资源，运行时再执行这些限制。
text.en: OpenShell is NVIDIA's runtime for autonomous AI agents. It aims to let agents read files, install packages, call APIs, and use controlled credentials without granting unrestricted access to host data, secrets, or networks. Users define the resources an agent may touch, and the runtime enforces those limits.

text.zh: 每个代理运行在隔离沙箱中，OpenShell在运行时约束文件访问、系统调用和网络连接。真实凭证不会直接暴露给代理，而是仅附加到发往获准端点的请求。策略变更在应用前还会经过形式化验证，用于标记新增主机、API方法或凭证访问，并将高风险变化交由人工审核。
text.en: Each agent runs in an isolated sandbox, while OpenShell governs file access, system calls, and network connections at runtime. Agents do not receive raw credentials directly; credentials are added only to requests bound for approved endpoints. Before a policy change is applied, formal verification flags newly granted access, such as a new host, API method, or credential path, for human review.

text.zh: 这套设计把代理安全从单次提示约束推进到运行时控制，适合需要管理多代理、网络访问和敏感凭证的团队。项目提供命令行工具、网关、Python、TypeScript、Go和Rust SDK，并支持通过Helm部署网关。当前前提包括Linux、Apple Silicon上的macOS，或实验性的WSL 2，以及Docker、Podman或主机虚拟化环境。
text.en: This design moves agent security beyond prompt-level restrictions toward runtime controls, which may help teams managing multiple agents, network access, and sensitive credentials. The project provides a CLI, gateway, Python, TypeScript, Go, and Rust SDKs, plus Helm-based gateway deployment. Its prerequisites include Linux, macOS on Apple Silicon, or experimental WSL 2, together with Docker, Podman, or host virtualization.

text.zh: 重要的开放问题是策略是否能覆盖组织真实工作流中的所有边界情况。形式化验证可以帮助审查策略变化，但不能替团队判断代理是否应该访问某项业务数据，也不能替代沙箱、网络策略和依赖材料的安全评估。OpenShell按Apache 2.0许可发布，并收集可关闭的匿名运营遥测；使用者仍需自行核查外部材料的安全性、许可和适用性。
text.en: The key open question is whether policies can cover every edge case in real organizational workflows. Formal verification can help review policy changes, but it cannot decide whether an agent should access a particular business dataset or replace security reviews of sandboxes, network policies, and retrieved dependencies. OpenShell is released under Apache 2.0 and collects opt-out anonymous operational telemetry; users remain responsible for assessing the security, licensing, and suitability of external materials.
